sha256chain.name: sha256chain
sha256chain.description: SHA-256 hash chain h_{i+1} = SHA-256(h_i) (#10): plain C, Zknh, RVV multi-buffer x16, accelerator (SHA-256 engine; SHA-512 and SHA3-256 chains on the streaming engine)
expect: KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 OK: C, Zknh, RVV x16
KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-512 / FIPS 202 SHA3-256 OK: accelerator
sha256chain.units: hashes per region (RVV x16: the hashes are split over 16 independent chains)

sha256chain_bulk.description: Bulk hashing of a 64 KiB buffer (#10): SHA-256 plain C, Zknh, RVV multi-buffer x16 (16 segments), accelerator SHA-512 and SHA3-256 (streaming engine)
expect: KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 OK: C, Zknh, RVV x16
KAT FIPS 180-4 SHA-512 / FIPS 202 SHA3-256 OK: accelerator
sha256chain_bulk.units: KiB of message per region (the buffer is iterations KiB)
